title: Translation identity for set integrals of C¹_c functions (FTC + Fubini)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, F ⊆ ℝⁿ a Borel set, ζ : ℝⁿ → ℝ a C¹ function with compact support, w ∈ ℝⁿ and t ∈ ℝ. Then ∫_F ζ(z − t w) dLⁿ(z) = ∫_F ζ(z) dLⁿ(z) − ∫_0^t ( ∫_F Dζ(z − s w)(w) dLⁿ(z) ) ds, where ∫_0^t is the oriented interval integral (∫_0^t = −∫_t^0 when t < 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ z in F, ζ (z - t • w) = (∫ z in F, ζ z) - ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, ∫ z in F, fderiv ℝ ζ (z - s • w) w
